name: Tap That Date!
source:
You've asked your crush out on a date... to your place! But your home resembles a dumpster. Can you clean up to win your date's heart?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Tap_That_Date!]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你已经邀请你的暗恋对象去你家约会了！但你的家就像一个垃圾箱。你能打扫干净来赢得约会对象的心吗？

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Tap_That_Date!]Choices Wikia[/url]]
